newsitem.title: USA: U.S. copper rod output rises in Sept - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. copper rod output rises in Sept - ABMS.

text.p: U.S. copper rod production rose to 355,656 short tons in September, up 14,362 tons from August, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics reported.
In the first nine months of 1996, copper rod production totalled 3,127,963 tons, up from 2,806,100 tons in the same period in 1995.
Total cathode consumption in rod production was 349,000 tons in September, up from 338,982 tons in August.
Total rod inventories were 105,188 tons September, down from 121,239 tons in August.
Total rod receipts in September were 347,855 tons, barely changed from the August total of 347,675 tons.
Rod shipments in September fell to 361,724 tons from the August total of 371,727 tons.
